events.text: Team Leader, what does the map look like from your side?
Maybe there's another interpretation of the map.
We can't move without the map.
Alright, here's the cleanest interpretation: the room splits into three sections, hidden panel east side.
Yeah, that's the piece we were missing.
Puzzle Solver, what have you got on the pattern?
There's a pattern forming — that fits.
If I flip it: east wall's done. Lock pattern next: the ceiling symbols — triangle, then circle, then square.
Nice one — that helps a lot.
Code Breaker, we can't move without the key. Talk to me.
Oh lovely, that's a weight off.
What if the pattern doesn't mean what we thought? Quick sanity check.
We can't move without the key.
Another way to read it: magnetic key, attached to the metal panel.
That one holds — push onto the next.
Good. Keep moving.
Scout, do you have anything on the code?
Reading the map again — what if there's a second layer to it?
This might help us: four, two, seven, one.
Yeah.
Nice, that opens the next bit right up.
Entering 4-2-7-1. Hold.
Yes — door's open. That was the last piece.
